_metadata.description: AnSA NemoClaw PoC - Persons of Interest Watchlist

persons_of_interest.name: Abubakar Musa Ibrahim
persons_of_interest.notes: Subject linked to financial fraud network operating across North-East region. Last flagged entering FCT via Abuja-Keffi Expressway on 2026-03-10. Known to use multiple aliases. Exercise caution during approach.

persons_of_interest.name: Chinedu Okafor
persons_of_interest.notes: Principal suspect in cross-border arms trafficking ring. Interpol Red Notice active. Believed to have connections with operatives in Cameroon and Niger Republic. Armed and dangerous — do not approach without tactical support.

persons_of_interest.name: Fatima Bello Yusuf
persons_of_interest.notes: Person of interest in cybercrime investigation. Suspected involvement in BEC (Business Email Compromise) syndicate targeting international corporations. No history of violence.

persons_of_interest.name: Emeka Nnamdi Eze
persons_of_interest.notes: Associate of POI-1103. Believed to provide logistical support only. No direct involvement in violent activities confirmed. Under surveillance for information gathering.

persons_of_interest.name: Halima Abdullahi Sani
persons_of_interest.notes: Suspected of recruiting for extremist network through online platforms. Multiple social media accounts flagged. Known to travel frequently between Kaduna and Abuja. Surveillance priority.

persons_of_interest.name: Oluwaseun Adeyemi
persons_of_interest.notes: Linked to counterfeit currency distribution ring operating in South-West region. Subject has prior convictions for forgery. Last spotted conducting transactions at Bodija Market on 2026-03-05.

persons_of_interest.name: Musa Danjuma Lawal
persons_of_interest.notes: Prime suspect in multiple kidnapping-for-ransom incidents along Abuja-Jos highway. Armed and extremely dangerous. Active warrant from FCT High Court. Reward offered for information leading to arrest.
